name: worldbuild
description: Build a fictional universe on disk that is seeded from your own memory, then masked and transposed into myth. A low-pressure interrogation that never asks for a list and opens in the present tense, tuned for dictation as well as typing, with invented riffs treated as first-class roots. Includes a voice system with a checker, an influence dial for weighting which writers the world is written through, a drift registry for questions the world must never answer, and a lineage check that every entry traces back to something a human supplied.
